name: Lumasaba
region: Eastern Uganda (Bugisu, Mount Elgon): Mbale, Sironko, Manafwa, Bududa, Bulambuli, Namisindwa
translator_note: Mbale-town Lumasaba (Lugisu) in the Bugisu standard orthography: kh, ts and sh, class prefixes umu-/ba-, shi-/bi-, i-/tsi-, ku-, lu-, khu- for the infinitive, and the Bugisu greeting Mulembe on the welcome screen. Verbs: Nina (board), Kabana (share), Pangisa (rent), Ruma (send); Tila khu UG for Book, Khupa isimu for Call ahead, Runga for pay. Loans that Mbale speech already uses (app, boda, taxi, paaka, jaamu, sikaani, koodi, linki, kaadi, lisiiti) are kept; concepts with no Lumasaba word (plug-in, endpoint, API key, sandbox, concierge, arbitrage desk) are paraphrased. The choice of Runga over the Luganda loan sasula, the perfective passive shapes (-wa versus -ibwa), the words for day (shifukhu), truth (bubwene) and trust (bwisiki), and some Bukusu-shaped forms are the least certain and are listed under uncertain.

strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Tsimaapu khurula khu Felt. Tsinkola tsye mbeera ye shibala khurula khu Infrared City. Bye khwisangasa khurula khu Tazama. Khufuga nikhubula makhono khurula khu Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli shiyungwakho ni shiyunga shili ni anwani yasho ni shisumuluso shasho, bibikhwa khu shyuma shino ukhuula ni wingila. Yunga shilala, tsipeesa tsikhwana tsyaka mu Kabana, Khena ni Hustle Mode. Khubula shirula mu UG nishibula shiyungwakho shye wakoleesa.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Bahakani barwa khu lukalala khu bwene. Umukendi wisika khulinganisa akalukha khu khukabana ni khupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG ni shisoko khuranga. Tsi-app tsye khulanga tsimotoka tsinyoola bitilwa byitsuule nitsibula khurunga khunyoola bakasitoma. Bapangisi be tsimotoka banyoola bapangisi be wiikendi bakebelwa. Tsilodge tsinyoola bikuundi byuula khu shifukhu shimanyikhane. Badereeva banyoola ingila yitsuule nibashili khurula.

strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Ikhumi khu buli mia khu khukabana, tsisente tsilala tsye khura imotoka khu khupangisa, khurungwa buli wiiki khu MoMo khubira mu Flutterwave, ni bakasitoma be ukhalanga khulangila.
